product: AHCCCS Fee-For-Service / American Indian Health Program

adoptionSources.evidence: Official page defines FFS formulary for FFS program members; explicitly not applicable to health-plan members.
Official AIHP Drug Lists section links the exact November1,2026 FFS PDF as AHCCCS American Indian Health Plan Drug List.
AIHP is acute FFS. Official FAQ identifies Tribal ALTCS, including Pascua Yaqui and Tohono Oodham, as FFS programs, subject to member enrollment and service/billing context.

scopeCaveat: This FFS list must not substitute for an MCO formulary. Medicare dual-eligible/PartD benefits and Tribal/IHS dispensing/billing require applicable program rules; no automatic MCO or PartD mapping.
